THE GAME

Co-op · Mining · Crafting

TrashCaves is a first-person co-op game for 1 to 4 players. Dig anywhere in a whole mountain, forge what you find with your own hands and sell everything in your little shop.

Every day has three parts. The expedition lasts as long as the oil in your lantern: go down, dig, fight and climb back loaded. The workshop has no clock: smelt, forge, cook, brew and fill the displays. Then ring the bell, open the door and watch the customers react to your prices.

The mountain remembers every tunnel, so the crew really does carve its own way to the bottom. Up top there is a farm to tend, a lake to fish in and a village whose neighbors have opinions about your shop.

WHAT'S INSIDE

01

Dig anywhere

No cubes and no grid. The hole takes the shape of your swing, and a hard vein stands out from the soft rock around it.

02

Forge by hand

Tip the crucible, hammer on the beat, quench in water. The quality comes from your hands, not from a timer.

03

Run the shop

Set the price, read the customer's face and keep an eye on the ones who came to steal.

04

Four friends, one workshop

Miner, smith, seller: the roles come from what the crew needs that day. Playing alone works too.

05

Classes and skills

Warrior, mage, ranger or priest. Swap whenever you like and grow a skill tree for each one.

06

Farm, lake and village

Plant crops, raise animals, go fishing, try recipes in the cauldron and show up for the festival.
